patterns.note: An asymmetrical, flexible image grid is used to display artworks, allowing for varying aspect ratios and sizes to create a curated, gallery-like presentation.
A distinctive, hand-drawn signature-style logotype is prominently featured as the main brand identifier and as a large, faded graphic in the footer.
A highly restrained, almost monochromatic palette of off-white and light beige/green is used for backgrounds and text, allowing the vibrant colors of the artworks to stand out.
The main navigation bar sticks to the top of the viewport on scroll, retaining its full size and styling, while a narrow promotional banner above it completely disappears.
A consistent, minimal footer anchors the page with a large, faded rendition of the site's signature logotype, providing a subtle yet strong brand presence.

technique_notes: The site implements a sticky header that maintains its full initial size and styling, while a narrow promotional banner positioned directly above it is designed to completely disappear from view as the user scrolls down the page.
Content is displayed in a flexible, masonry-like grid where image sizes and aspect ratios vary, creating an organic, gallery-like presentation without strict column alignment.

design_tokens.type_scale: A balanced type scale with clear hierarchy; headings are moderately larger than body text, and a distinct handwritten display font is used for branding.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for all interactive elements, images, and containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and open, with generous padding around grid items and sections, contributing to a gallery-like, uncrowded feel.

standout: The most distinctive element is the integration of the artist's unique, hand-drawn signature as a prominent design element, appearing as the main logo and a large, faded graphic in the footer. This personal touch, combined with the asymmetrical, gallery-style grid and muted color palette, creates an authentic and art-focused experience that feels less like a typical e-commerce site and more like a curated exhibition.
